story_type: lifeboat surfman course in big breaking surf, drone view from above
hook: This lifeboat drove into a breaking wave on purpose.
narration: This Coast Guard lifeboat drove straight into a breaking wave on purpose.
It was surfman training at Clatsop Spit, where the Columbia River meets the Pacific.
A surfman is the coxswain trusted to drive these forty-seven foot lifeboats through breaking surf.
The boat is built to roll all the way over and right itself in seconds.
Wave after wave, the students turned the bow into the white water.
outcome: The surfman students drove the lifeboat back out of the breakers, upright and running.
title: Lifeboat drives into breaking waves
description:
Coast Guard Surfman Class 01-26 trains in the surf at Clatsop Spit, Oregon, on Nov. 23, 2025, filmed by drone.
